notes: Companies House 14332843 is the UK operating subsidiary; its accounts name Orbital Materials Inc. (USA) as parent and controlling party. Equity was raised at the US parent, so there are no SH01 allotments in the UK filings and the UK headcount (5, 8, 8) understates the group.
No SEC Form D found: EDGAR full-text search for 'Orbital Materials' and 'Orbital Industries' (forms=D) and the company-name search returned nothing.

Seed amount ($4.8M, July 2023) is from secondary databases (Dealroom-type profiles); TechCrunch's '~$21M total' after the $16M A is consistent with it. Leads Fly Ventures and Compound are named as 'returning Seed leads' in the Series A release.
Total disclosed equity about $71M (Resilience Media, May 2026); NVentures amount undisclosed.

Rebranded from Orbital Materials to Orbital Industries by May 2026; orbitalmaterials.com 301-redirects to orbitalindustries.com. Products now pitched at AI data centres (PFAS-free immersion-cooling fluid, modular high-density compute platform 'Orbital IT'), with a multi-year AWS partnership; offices London and San Francisco, earlier R&D lab near Princeton NJ.
OpenAlex has no institution record; works search on the raw affiliation string finds 10 works and 5 distinct Orbital-affiliated authors (2023-2026), a weak lower bound.
